column3: NASB has no “to Him,” like the critical text; “go before you into” is rendered “will get into … before you.”
“Repent” (change one’s mind) is rendered “feel remorse”; NASB adds “this.”
NASB renders “a man, a master of a house” as “a landowner,” “fence” as “wall,” and “farmers” as “vine-growers”; the Old Testament wording is in capitals.
NASB renders “season of the fruits” as “harvest time,” “servants” as “slaves,” and “fruits” as “produce.”
NASB adds “group of” and renders “more” as “larger.”
NASB follows the critical text (“have,” rendered “seize”).
NASB renders “grievously destroy the wretches” as “bring those wretches to a wretched end” and “fruits” as “proceeds.”
NASB adds an italicized “stone” to “chief corner” and prints the quotation in capitals.
“Grind to powder” is rendered “scatter him like dust.” The critical text marks this verse as doubtful, but NASB prints it without brackets.
NASB follows the critical text (“considered Him to be”); “crowds” is rendered “the people.”
